_note: Dormant: these start tags own no state at the start date (mapgen/derived/state_ownership.json), so the validator and the generators do not read this folder and the entries may be stale. When a tag gains land, move its entry back into the region file (and its baseline here if the region file is gone).

baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Lizardmen army book (Slann Mage-Priests rule temple-cities through Skink priests, Saurus spawn as the warrior host, isolated by the Old Ones' design)
baseline.why: Lizardmen temple-cities are ruled absolutely by a Slann theocracy with a Saurus warrior caste, isolated, without markets or schooling beyond temple lore
